drums.tags: Percussion ensemble piece featuring a variety of hand drums and body percussion. The track is built around a syncopated, polyrhythmic structure with a steady pulse. It features low-tuned tom-toms or floor toms providing a resonant, thumping bass foundation, while higher-pitched hand drums like congas or bongos execute rapid, sixteenth-note patterns and sharp accents. Handclaps and rhythmic chest-slapping add organic, mid-range textures. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement focuses on rhythmic interplay and dynamic builds, with sections alternating between sparse, singular drum hits and dense, layered tribal-style grooves. No melodic or harmonic instruments are present.

[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[single resonant drum hits with long decay]
[rhythmic chest slapping and handclaps enter]

[Main Section]
[syncopated hand drum pattern enters]
[low-tuned floor toms provide steady quarter note pulse]
[rapid sixteenth-note conga fills]

[Build-up]
[increased density of handclaps and rimshots]
[crescendo of polyrhythmic drumming]

[Outro]
[drums drop out leaving only handclaps]
[final resonant bass drum hit]

bass.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. A driving drum kit features a prominent snare on 2 and 4 with rapid double-kick patterns and frequent crash cymbal accents. The electric bass follows the guitar riffs with a gritty, overdriven tone. The track is in 4/4 time at 140 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement alternates between dense rhythmic sections and brief melodic lead guitar flourishes using pinch harmonics.
